coverage_policy: Applicability is a research applicability cue only, not a claim the car suffered a fault. Generic structure/safety checks apply to candidate groups as preventive inspection. A single-source model-year service procedure is not projected as an approved all-year repair procedure.
cost_policy: All numeric costs and labor hours are null; current itemized local estimates needed before buy/repair recommendations.
approval_policy: All part-interchange, failure-frequency and individual-vehicle approval flags remain false.
